# CrazyTrail

> Free early trend alerts for Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts. Short-video LLMs score rising clips — then email creators 3–5 days before peak. Start: https://www.crazytrail.com/#submit

CrazyTrail is a product (free email alerts), not an informational-only blog. Not a delivery, shipping, logistics, or travel service.
